perplexity.description:
Fireworks City is the second and final studio album by English group Audioweb, released in 1998 on Mother Records and produced by Stephen Lironi. The album showcases the band's fusion of electronic, rock, and reggae influences, blending digital production with organic instrumentation and rhythmic experimentation. Tracks like "Policeman Skank (The Story of My Life)" and "Soul On Fire" exemplify this eclectic approach, combining synth-driven arrangements with reggae-inflected rhythms and rock sensibilities.

As Audioweb's concluding full-length release, Fireworks City represents the culmination of the group's sonic exploration across their brief recording career. The album's eleven tracks demonstrate a band comfortable navigating between genres, incorporating elements of dub, funk, and alternative rock into a cohesive electronic framework. The production maintains clarity across these diverse influences, allowing each song's distinct character to emerge while maintaining thematic consistency.

The album received positive critical reception, with contemporary reviews recognizing its ambitious genre-blending approach. While specific commercial performance data is limited, Fireworks City has maintained relevance among collectors and electronic music enthusiasts, evidenced by its 2021 vinyl reissue on Demon Records in colored vinyl format, introducing the album to a new generation of listeners interested in late-1990s electronic and alternative music.
